test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an examination, a student scored 65% marks but was 20 marks below the qualifying marks. Another student scored 80% marks and scored 10 marks more than the qualifying marks. Total marks of the examination are:
solution:
**Given:**

Marks scored by one student = 65%

Marks scored by another student = 80% 

**Solution:**

Let the total marks be = y 

Qualifying marks of one student = 65% of y + 20 

Qualifying marks of another student = 80% of y - 10

 As per the question;

65% of y + 20 = 80% of y - 10

⇒ 65/100 × y + 30 = 80/100 × y 

⇒ 30 = 80y/100 - 65y/100 

⇒ 15y/100 = 30 

⇒ y = 200 

**∴ The total marks of the examination are 200.**
